component.name: Lurker
component.summary: Watch Twitch channels with their chat

description.p: A native desktop client for watching Twitch. Streams play through mpv, without ads, alongside a chat with 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes.

ul.li: Browse followed channels, top streams and categories
Open other channels' chats as splits beside the video
Watch past broadcasts with seeking and chat replay
Choose the quality, or switch to low latency

description.p: Lurker is not affiliated with or endorsed by Twitch.
